offersHint: Browse Aevum Security's Singapore cybersecurity services and submit a business enquiry. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://agents.aevumsecurity.com.sg/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Agent key as 'Bearer <key>'. Only required for the mutating submit_enquiry tool; the read-only tools work without it. Request a key at enquiries@aevumsecurity.com.sg.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Optional. Agent key as 'Bearer <key>'. Only required for the mutating submit_enquiry tool; the read-only tools work without it. Request a key at enquiries@aevumsecurity.com.sg.

toolsPreview.name: list_services
toolsPreview.description: Aevum Security's cybersecurity services: slug, name and a one-line summary. The slug is the service identifier accepted by get_service_details and submit_enquiry.

toolsPreview.name: get_service_details
toolsPreview.description: Full details of one Aevum Security service, by slug from list_services.

toolsPreview.name: submit_enquiry
toolsPreview.description: Submits a business enquiry to Aevum Security on behalf of the caller's principal. Creates a real enquiry that a person reads and replies to within 1 business day; it cannot be withdrawn once submitted. Returns the enquiry id as proof of receipt. [MUTATING: requires an agent key passed as Authorization: Bearer on the HTTP connection]
